## [0.30.0] - 2026-09-15

This release improves constant-RPS load-test pacing accuracy on Linux and macOS.

### Changed

- **Linux and macOS: constant-RPS load runs are more evenly paced at low-to-moderate rates.** Load-generation threads previously slept with no correction for wakeup overshoot, so a tick could land late and the next one paid it back as a doubled dispatch - the same effect Windows already had fixed. Pacing now uses each OS's precise timer, and worker threads are pinned to their own CPU core when the configured worker count leaves one spare.
- Internal: the Windows engine build fixed a macro-name collision with two of libcurl's Windows headers.
